international.title: Elon Musk joins 165,000 others calling for Nvidia to bring back Jensen Huang in open letter
international.summary: Push to reinstate CEO ousted after affair with suspected Chinese spy, as US treasury secretary urges ‘dramatic shake-up’ at tech firm Megaspeed says it’s a ‘legitimate and lawful business’ Business live – latest updates Elon Musk and a host of other tech bosses have called for Jensen Huang’s reinstatement at Nvidia, amid reports the former chief executive is already plotting a return to the chip company just four days after his resignation. An open letter, which has more than 165,000 signatories, demands that the company’s board members “bring Jensen back while an independent investigation establishes the facts”. Continue reading...
